name: Pactiv Evergreen - Aberdeen NC
type: Manufacturing Plant (Food Merchandising; foam tray/pad converting)

fieldNotes.truckGate: Driveway runs directly from NC Hwy 5 across a CSX-type rail spur into the property with no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint. Confirmed via 2024-05 Street View at the driveway entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth or staffed structure at the entrance in any Street View heading.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Driveway crosses the rail line then runs ~120 m before reaching the dock apron - room for a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: South-facing dock face has a covered loading canopy (~3-4 doors) plus 2-3 additional bays to the east; total estimated 6-10. Partly obscured by canopy in satellite - low confidence, banded 0-10.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large open paved yard east of the building can hold trailers but few were parked in imagery; banded 0-10 for trailers actually observed dropped.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Open paved east yard could hold ~20-25 trailers if striped/used; estimate only.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the property's south edge parallel to NC Hwy 5, but no spur enters the property and docks are not rail-facing - rail not served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town light-industrial corridor on NC Hwy 5 in Aberdeen, surrounded by pine woods - Rural.
